lines.text: The LORD says He will send to Babylon and bring the Chaldeans as fugitives in their ships.
The LORD makes a way in the sea, and chariots and horses lie down never to rise again.
The LORD will make a way in the mountains and streams in the desert to give drink to His chosen people.
The LORD says Jacob has not called on Him, and has burdened Him with their complaints.
The LORD blots out Israel's transgressions for His own sake and remembers their sins no more.
